feature_definitions.preset-effects: Umbriel named effect presets and selectors; the original preset API was introduced at 512e2fb3.
feature_definitions.workspace-reveal-full-scene: Full-scene workspace reveal: outgoing and incoming scene sampling, including umbriel_sample_incoming, with reveal mode. Older root-mask and scene-v1 interfaces are incompatible.
feature_definitions.cursor-pointer-history: Cursor pointer history via umbriel_pointer_count and umbriel_pointer_path[64].

effects.name: Beach Surf Animation
effects.description: A water-and-foam window reveal and disappearance.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Blood In
effects.description: Wave of blood reveals the window top to bottom.
effects.author: WinterMyst

effects.name: Blood Out
effects.description: Drains out the bottom with same wave as Blood In.
effects.author: WinterMyst

effects.name: Blood Sweep
effects.description: A wave of blood covers the outgoing workspace and reveals the incoming scene.
effects.author: WinterMyst

effects.name: Cells
effects.description: Opening traces glowing pentagonal lines outward from the centre, fills the cells with the window, then withdraws the lines from the perimeter back to the centre.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Cloud Puff
effects.description: A quick, outward-billowing cloud puff for window opening and closing.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Flame Grilled
effects.description: Opening sweeps tall, rolling flames downward and leaves the window behind.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Fractal Bloom
effects.description: Windows appear and disappear through a mirrored kaleidoscope mandala.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Fractal Iris
effects.description: A rolling fractal front reveals the incoming workspace.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Ghostly Tear
effects.description: A ghost-lit hole opens at the exact centre of the screen and rips outwards through the outgoing workspace.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Glitch
effects.description: Opening vibrates the window into existence through displaced digital bands, staggered blocks, and RGB separation.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: kzzzt Close
effects.description: Closing overdrives the window's own colours into phosphor and tears it into bands, then blows it out like a fuse, with one overexposed pop and a short fading afterglow of its brightest pixels.
effects.author: weegs710

effects.name: kzzzt Open
effects.description: Opening strikes the window into being with one overexposed, torn frame, then it stutters in through displaced bands and phosphor bloom while circuit traces flare at its edges and settle.
effects.author: weegs710

effects.name: Magic
effects.description: Opening reveals the window from a violet puff surrounded by drifting golden four-point sparkles.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Old TV
effects.description: Closing collapses the picture into a horizontal phosphor line, then a brighter central blink that lingers before winking out.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Paper Animation
effects.description: A sheet falls and unfurls on opening, then scrunches and falls away on closing.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Rangoli Iris
effects.description: A circular iris inspired by the user's floral reference: white petal outlines on red, green and orange bands, surrounded by blue beads with white spirals.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Reveal
effects.description: A bundled opening and closing reveal animation.
effects.author: Noctalia

effects.name: Shattered Glass
effects.description: Opening reassembles an irregular fracture map.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Squash
effects.description: A bundled squash deformation for window movement.
effects.author: Noctalia

effects.name: Triangle Flaps
effects.description: Equilateral triangles point alternately up and down.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: TV Glitch
effects.description: An old CRT switching on and off: the picture tears into horizontally displaced, tinted noise bands, then collapses into a bright line and a dot.
effects.author: Simon Schneegans; port by Barrulus

effects.name: Vampire Blood Wash
effects.description: A Vampire-family workspace reveal: a thick wine-red wash rolls over the entire scene with rounded rivulets, crimson streaks and a glossy wet edge.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: VHS
effects.description: Opening introduces the window through horizontal tape stretch, rolling tracking errors, scanlines, noise, and colour bleed.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Void
effects.description: Opening grows a broad violet vortex around a black core and releases the twisting window.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Water Conjure
effects.description: A drop lands, a water column rises, and a foamy frame fills inward; closing reverses into a puddle.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Water Splash
effects.description: A water-drop impact seen from above, intended for closing windows.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Wet Paint
effects.description: Opening pours long, uneven paint streams down the window.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Witching Hour
effects.description: A ragged portal burns through the entire outgoing scene, revealing the next one in place, including wallpaper, windows, decorations and shell surfaces.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Wobbly Lifecycle
effects.description: Elastic-sheet deformation for opening and closing windows.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Wobbly Move
effects.description: Elastic deformation during animated moves, resizes, and layout changes.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Workspace Burn
effects.description: A noisy advancing burn front consumes the outgoing scene, with a narrow orange hot rim and a broader charred edge.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Workspace CRT Scanline
effects.description: A narrow scanning beam replaces the outgoing scene with RGB separation, jittered strips, scanlines and electronic noise.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Workspace Dust Cloud
effects.description: Both stationary scenes fracture into tiny drifting chips; overlapping dust clouds disperse and gather into the destination.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Workspace Glitch Phase
effects.description: Video tears and misregistered colour channels accompany staggered block replacement across the whole scene.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Workspace Iris
effects.description: A clean circular aperture opens from the centre, revealing the incoming scene without moving either image.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Workspace Melt
effects.description: The outgoing scene drips along the workspace navigation axis while the destination stays in place.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Workspace Noctalia Wave
effects.description: An irregular diagonal wave turns the scene into dark purple mosaic tiles, then flips the tiles into the destination.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Workspace Sand Collapse
effects.description: The outgoing scene breaks into tiny rigid grains that lose support in irregular pockets and accelerate downward.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Workspace Shatter
effects.description: Cracks spread through the outgoing scene before irregular rigid shards rotate and fall away, exposing the intact destination.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Workspace Tile Gravity
effects.description: Rigid rectangular tiles release at staggered times, mostly from the bottom upward, then tumble and fall away.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Workspace VHS Ripple
effects.description: A ripple with strong VHS tracking bands, horizontal jitter, RGB separation, scanlines, and noise over the native workspace slide.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Workspace Transporter
effects.description: Continuous blue-white shafts carry vertical streaks of the outgoing scene, with drifting glints, then clear to the destination.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Workspace Venetian Blinds
effects.description: Horizontal slats turn in perspective and cascade to edge-on, revealing the destination between them.
effects.author: Barrulus

effects.name: Workspace Wipe
effects.description: A straight edge reveals the incoming scene along the workspace navigation axis.
effects.author: Barrulus
